description: Iaroslava is a young girl with lots of hang-ups. She has an older sister who is already a famous huntress despite having graduated recently. She quickly fit in to the elite squad and was appointed valedictorian. Iaroslava admired her older sister and decided to join the Academy. However, her performance in the preliminary tests was mediocre. When asked if she was related to the famous huntress, she chose to hide the truth, too afraid of any comparison. She swore to herself that she would do everything in her power to be able to compete with her sister one day. With such will, what would she have to fear in the future?
summon: One day, I'll be greater than you... You will be proud of me!
fusion: I don't need to be friends with my squad...
